# Single-outfit review asset

Square_Denim_Review.glb is a fitted, skinned 3D top/jeans asset, not a reference-picture plane. It includes five material batches, original small fabric maps and the compatible retained skeleton. Source authoring: ../../square-denim-outfit.js; reproducible exporter: ../../../tools/export-square-denim.mjs. No Blender dependency is required to run the game or rebuild this asset.

Required owner design: reference/outfits/Female_Wardrobe_Collection/01_Casual_Streetwear/Denim_and_Everyday_Tops.png, rightmost column. The reference PNG belongs to the owner and is used only as the catalogue/review picture. It is not embedded in the wearable GLB. Back construction is plain and inferred with the owner's permission.

Garment surface fitting uses the existing Quaternius CC0 character topology/rig. The retained license is copied alongside this file. Project-authored garment cut, widening, UVs, fabric textures and construction details remain portable source. Existing project MIT/third-party notices are retained.

Status: unapproved review candidate. It is enabled only in ?review=outfit. Existing story wardrobe IDs, ownership, looks and the rejected default entries remain unchanged until the owner approves a replacement. See ../../../qa/exact-outfit-review/STATUS.md for differences and missing live visual evidence.
